title: In online university courses, meta-cognitive scaffolding had the largest effect, g = 1.10
subtitle: Average effect on learning outcomes by type of scaffolding, with 95% confidence intervals, from a meta-analysis of 64 effect sizes (18 studies, 2010–2019). Conceptual and strategic rest on five effect sizes each.

source.authors: Doo, M. Y., Bonk, C. J., & Heo, H.
